nyalkan.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
nyalkan.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: ON (Sub-block): Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
nyalkan.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables culling for entities on not visible sections.
nyalkan.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
nyalkan.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but increases GPU overhead. Enabling it might help in CPU limited systems.
nyalkan.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.toolti: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
